title: Twilio trial accounts will not send your own SMS text; Body must be a template name such as sms_2fa
symptoms: Quickstart send code with a custom Body fails on a new trial account
Only to, body and statusCallback can be set on a trial send
cause: Trial accounts may only send Twilio provided message templates, chosen by name in the body parameter, to verified US numbers. Custom text arrives only after upgrading.
fix: During the trial pass a template name as body, or upgrade the account before testing real copy.
affected: Twilio trial accounts; trial SMS rules as published 2026-08-13; trials also expire after 30 days
